interpretation: registered technical value of a channel (manufacturer code, technical text/epoch value, or numeric reading outside the permissible range); not a confirmed device failure
value: value_numeric, else value_raw parsed as a number (comma accepted as decimal separator)
range_rule: technical if value < min or value > max; bounds themselves are valid
alarm_rule: technical status does not depend on alarm; per organizer answer a technical value is excluded from measurements only when the record is not alarm-flagged (measurement_exclusion_sql)
common_codes_source: organizer answers (manufacturer technical values -100, 255, -127, -3276; error sent as a number instead of -255)

Датчик температуры.range_basis: proxy: common industrial electronics operating range -40..+85 degC combined with development data (p0.1 = -51, p99.9 = 102 incl. faulty channels; readings above 85 jump by a median 55 degC from the previous reading); device model and datasheet not received
Датчик температуры.sensitivity_range_basis: open datasheet of 1-Wire digital thermometers (Maxim DS18B20: -55..+125 degC); applicability to customer sensors unconfirmed
Датчик температуры.text_values_basis: development: every 'Не определено' temperature row shares its timestamp with a numeric reading; 96.9% of those readings are -127 (5,225), below -40 (1,173) or above 85 (231); 212 are within range; the text row carries alarm=true in 86% of rows

Газовый датчик.codes_basis: hypothesis by data: values are integer counts x 0.01; 2.55/-2.56/327.68 correspond to 255/-256/32768 and appear as isolated spikes between readings near 0 (96-100% of occurrences)
Газовый датчик.range_basis: physical: volume fraction cannot be negative or exceed 100%; no negative readings before 2020-10 on development; methane LEL 4.4% vol (IEC/GOST 60079-20-1) is an alarm-relevant level, not a validity bound
Газовый датчик.zero_basis: development: 0.0 alternates with 0.01 at the resolution step (97% of zeros preceded by a 0.01 step in 2023), isolated zero spikes 0.03-0.07% of zeros

ИБП.range_basis: proxy by data only (development min 0, max 100); meaning of the value not confirmed

Состояние охраны.unit: date-time text of the guard state (meaning unconfirmed)
Состояние охраны.range_basis: not numeric; only the epoch placeholder value is technical
Состояние охраны.text_prefixes_basis: organizer lists the epoch date '01.01.1970 03:00' among technical values; on development it occurs as a sensor VALUE (46,055 rows, 29 of 46 channels, never alarm), not as a timestamp; is_epoch_placeholder marks exactly these rows while their event timestamps parse normally

not_in_rule.epoch_placeholder: rows with an epoch placeholder in the timestamp itself would be unplaceable; on development none exist: the epoch occurs only as a value of 'Состояние охраны' (in the rule) and of rows without sensor type (out of scope)
not_in_rule.temperature_zero: 0.0 is flagged sentinel_candidate but is a plausible reading; isolated zero spikes are a sensitivity candidate only
not_in_rule.stuck_value: the source reports on change (identical consecutive values are rare), so an unchanged value for N hours is indistinguishable from silence; sensitivity only

sources: organizer Q&A (manufacturer technical values, permissible range, external heating, alarm-flag rule)
customer answer on gas unit: % vol methane, alarm setpoint 1% (docs/ML_TASK_SPEC_V3.md, B3)
IEC 60079-20-1 / GOST 31610.20-1: methane lower explosive limit 4.4% vol
Maxim Integrated DS18B20 datasheet: measurement range -55..+125 degC, power-on reset value +85 degC
DallasTemperature open library convention: -127 = device disconnected
text_rule: value_raw equal to a configured text value ('text_code') or starting with a configured prefix ('epoch_value') is technical regardless of value_numeric; checked before codes and ranges
